claim: NullPropagatedOperands recurses into binary.Left/binary.Right for every SqlBinaryExpression operator type, including AndAlso, OrElse and Coalesce, which do not propagate NULL. Operands reached only through such a node are wrongly recorded as null-propagating, so DropNotNullChecks deletes a load-bearing IS NOT NULL guard and the CASE wrapper is removed, yielding wrong scalar values and wrong rows.
raw: NullPropagatedOperands treats AndAlso/OrElse as null-propagating, so a load-bearing IS NOT NULL guard is deleted

claim: A SqlBinaryExpression with ExpressionType.Coalesce also reaches the buggy recursion arm — legal per SqlBinaryExpression.IsValidOperator and constructible via the public SqlExpressionFactory.MakeBinary — but the core translator emits COALESCE as a SqlFunctionExpression, so no core-translator repro could be built.
raw: [unverified] SqlBinaryExpression with ExpressionType.Coalesce also reaches the buggy arm

raw: [minor] func.Instance! dereferenced on InstancePropagatesNullability alone, inconsistent with sibling at :2394
